chunks: And by this chain, he disliked that the man copulates while facing the Qiblah.
ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to have intercourse facing the Qiblah?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the recommended dislike (karahat) of facing the Qiblah during marital intercourse, a view supported by many Shia jurists as a sign of reverence for the direction of prayer. While not considered strictly prohibited (haram), it reflects the broader Islamic emphasis on maintaining spiritual awareness and etiquette even in physical intimacy. This ruling underscores the integration of ritual purity and spatial orientation into daily life within Shia fiqh.
